about:
About section.

I build high-traffic web platforms and the teams behind them, and I still ship the code myself.

At The Muse I rose from Senior Application Engineer to Senior Director of Engineering over seven years. I led a 15-engineer team, promoted 6 engineers to senior or lead roles, and launched on-site advertising that generated $994K in annualized new ad revenue without slowing the site. Earlier there I grew organic SEO traffic 10x and cut build times from 45 minutes to 75 seconds.

Today at Talent.com I find the highest-cost problems, prove the root cause with data, write the fix plan, and ship it. I restored Google Jobs indexing from zero to 1.5M+ new jobs a day, cut a failing PostgreSQL query from 15.8 seconds to 87 milliseconds, and raised test coverage from 59% to 91%. I also built the team's AI-assisted engineering platform on Claude Code, with multi-agent code review on every merge request.

Before that I raised ad viewability from 45% to 85% across Condé Nast's 30+ publications, including Vogue, The New Yorker and Wired.

What I'm good at
• Technical SEO and structured data at scale (Google for Jobs, JSON-LD, Search Console)
• Web performance and Core Web Vitals
• Ad tech and monetization (Google Ad Manager, Prebid)
• Platform modernization (TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Nx)
• Growing engineers into senior and lead roles

Portfolio and case studies at richarddillman.com
talent-com--staff-software-engineer:
Title "Staff Software Engineer". Dec 2025 to Present. Employment type Contract. Replace the description.

Job search marketplace connecting employers and jobseekers (12M monthly unique visitors, 70M monthly page views, 46.8M active jobs).

Embedded with a 10-engineer team. I find the highest-cost problems, write the fix plan, and route each fix to the team's engineers or ship it directly.

• Restored Google Jobs indexing from zero to 1.5M+ new jobs a day by proving 15.9M rejections came from a daily quota, not a rate limit.
• Reduced a failing PostgreSQL query on a 600 GB table from 15.8 seconds to 87 milliseconds (181x) and found the stuck process blocking database cleanup.
• Identified $60K/year in recoverable Google Geocoding spend, confirmed by Finance, in a location service consolidation PRD.
• Measured 45% duplication across job data sources and drove a cross-team decision to show one copy of each job without losing revenue.
• Traced a soft-404 spike of 39.5M URLs in Search Console to ~14.5M bot requests a day returning near-empty pages, then shipped the redirect and bot-detection fixes.
• Stopped releases from dropping 45.7% of apply clicks by keeping the server key stable across builds and loading it from AWS Secrets Manager.
• Raised jobseeker test coverage from 59% to 91% and shipped a staged upgrade (Next.js 15, Nx 22, React 19, next-intl v4) with zero production regressions.
• Migrated 4 frontends to a new authentication library behind a dual-implementation flag with zero auth downtime.
• Launched a team-shared AI engineering platform of 59 Claude Code skills and 21 agents, with multi-agent code review on every merge request, and seven other engineers have contributed to it.
